main_text.head: Sententia Cabbalistarū de gradib. cognitionis.

p.i: Scala intellectus apud Cabbalistas sic ordinatur:

main_text.p: Hanc Scalam Cabbalistæ vocant tabulam purifi-cationis notionum, & graduum ad notionem: de quâ eruditè scripserunt Reuchlinus in trib. libris Cabbalæ, Nicolaus Hemmingius de lege na-turæ, Paulus princeps de la scala, Petrus Gregorius Tholozanus comment. prolegom. art. mirab. c.13. & seqq. Nos quia & pulcrè & verè hæc dicta sunt, & mirum in modum commendant sapientiam opificis, paucis enodabimus.

In cognitione quâlibet tria requiruntur, quæ sunt, intelligibile, intellectus, intelligens. Hoc est quodDecem Se-phiroth a-pud Cabba-listas. dicunt Cabbalistæ, hanc esse summam decem Sephi-roth, id est, omnium numerationum. Habent autem decem numerationes, quas sic vocant καθ᾽[?] ἐξο-χὴν, quia res quælibet intelligibilis secundum eas numerari potest. Hinc dicit Rabbi Abraham in Jezi-Tria requi-sita cogni-tionis.

page.notes: Left-margin notes "Tria requisita cognitionis" and "Decem Sephiroth apud Cabbalistas" are placed at the start of the paragraph and the phrase "Hoc est quod" respectively, as printed beside those lines. The Greek "καθ᾽ ἐξοχὴν" is read with doubt in its first word (printed form resembles "xal'"), marked [?]. Diagram labels to the right of the boxes ("Non syllogizant...", "Viam discursui...", "Syllogizat.", "Non syllogizat.") are given as their own lines after their groups. Diagram hyphens are kept as printed at line ends. The right-hand edge of the neighbouring page is ignored.
